paragraph: C.J. Stroud zips a 42-yard touchdown pass to Nico Collins! The Texans beat the Colts 26-3 in Houston. Stroud tossed 2 more touchdowns to Kayshon Boutte and Marlin Klein. Will Anderson Jr. sacked Daniel Jones in the end zone for a safety! David Montgomery rumbled for 107 yards. The dominant win was Houston’s first at home this season. The Texans climbed to 4-6, while the Colts fell to 3-8.

big_words.definition: In control and hard to beat.
big_words.example: Leo’s dog was dominant in their tug-of-war over a sock.

paragraph: James Cook III rumbled for a touchdown as the Bills beat the Dolphins 26-9! Tyler Bass kicked a 54-yard field goal to put Buffalo up 6-0. Josh Allen tossed a touchdown pass to DJ Moore. Cook then scored from 1 yard out to stretch the lead to 20-3. Miami snagged an Allen pass and kicked a field goal. But Buffalo's defense was mighty, holding Miami to no touchdowns! The win lifted the Bills to 9-1, while Miami fell to 1-9.

big_words.example: Priya gave the soccer ball a mighty kick at recess.

paragraph: 56 yards away, Charlie Smyth booted a field goal as the first half ended! The kick brought the Saints within 16-10 in Chicago. Earlier, Caleb Williams had zipped a touchdown pass to Colston Loveland. The Saints began their rally when Tyler Shough found Alvin Kamara for a touchdown. Then Montez Sweat sacked Shough in the end zone for a safety! The Bears held on to win 21-13. Chicago won its fifth straight game and moved to 8-2.

big_words.definition: A push to catch up after falling behind.
big_words.example: Marcus led a rally to finish planting the garden before lunch.

paragraph: In Dallas, the Cowboys and Titans battled for a win. Dallas scored on its first 8 possessions and won 51-30! Dak Prescott tossed 4 touchdown passes and ran for another. Cam Ward zipped a 59-yard touchdown pass to Carnell Tate. Then Quinnen Williams gave Dallas more momentum with a strip-sack! Dallas ran the fumble back 70 yards. The win put the Cowboys at 5-6, while the Titans fell to 1-9.

big_words.definition: A push that helps something keep moving or growing.
big_words.example: Sofia gained momentum as her talent show dance got faster.

paragraph: Who kept on winning? The Lions did, beating the Buccaneers 31-21 in Detroit. Jared Goff tossed a touchdown to Amon-Ra St. Brown. Then Goff zipped a 57-yard touchdown pass to Jameson Williams! Bucky Irving ran in a score for Tampa Bay. Jahmyr Gibbs rumbled in for 2 touchdowns in the fourth quarter! Detroit stretched its winning streak to 6 games and moved to 8-2.

big_words.definition: A string of wins in a row.
big_words.example: Jamal had a streak of baking perfect cookies.

paragraph: The final score lit up Kansas City: Chiefs 34, Cardinals 7. Patrick Mahomes zipped a touchdown pass to Travis Kelce to start the scoring! Emmett Johnson rumbled in for another Chiefs touchdown. Arizona answered when Josh Johnson found Simi Fehoko for a touchdown. Mahomes hit Kelce again, then found Xavier Worthy for his third touchdown pass! The Chiefs put on a spectacular show for their third straight win. Kansas City climbed to 8-2, while Arizona moved to 3-8.

big_words.definition: Very exciting and amazing to see.
big_words.example: Hana made a spectacular splash at her swimming lesson.

paragraph: The Steelers fought back in Philadelphia, but the Eagles held on to win 19-16. Saquon Barkley dashed 38 yards for an Eagles touchdown! Jake Elliott later booted a 55-yard field goal. Aaron Rodgers hit Max Hurleman for a touchdown, bringing Pittsburgh within 3 points. Then Joe Milton found DeVonta Smith for a clutch first down! The Eagles snapped a 7-game skid and moved to 3-7.

big_words.definition: Coming through at just the right time.
big_words.example: Diego made a clutch grab before his library book hit the floor.

paragraph: Ryan Fitzgerald kicked a 37-yard field goal, and the Panthers won 35-33! Earlier, Mike Green sacked Bryce Young in the end zone for a safety. Then Devontez Walker raced 86 yards for a Ravens touchdown. Chuba Hubbard ran in a touchdown for Carolina. Derrick Henry put Baltimore ahead 33-32, but Fitzgerald’s kick sealed the comeback! The 5-5 Panthers kept a 2-game lead in the NFC South.

big_words.example: Ava made a comeback on her bike ride and caught up with her friends.

paragraph: Geno Smith zips a 16-yard touchdown pass to Sterling Shepard! It is Shepard’s second touchdown catch of the game. Breece Hall also grabs a touchdown pass from Smith. Justin Herbert runs for a Chargers touchdown and later finds Ladd McConkey for another. The Jets hold on for a thrilling 27-24 win in Los Angeles! They end a 5-game skid and improve to 3-8, while the Chargers fall to 1-9.

big_words.example: Kofi had a thrilling race through puddles on a rainy day.

paragraph: Jonah Coleman ran for 111 yards and 3 touchdowns as Denver beat Las Vegas 38-24! The Raiders erased a 17-point lead in Denver. Fernando Mendoza threw to Ian Thomas to tie it at 17-17. Coleman rumbled in from 4 yards out to put the Broncos back ahead. Mendoza later found Jack Bech to bring the Raiders within 7. Then Ja'Quan McMillian snagged a pass and raced 35 yards for a pick-six! The Broncos showed grit and won their 6th game in a row.

big_words.definition: The courage to keep going when something is hard.
big_words.example: Lily showed grit as she set up her lemonade stand.

paragraph: 23 points helped the Giants beat the Jaguars 23-18 in New York! Jameis Winston ran for a touchdown to put the Giants ahead. J.J. McCarthy then zipped a touchdown pass to Malik Nabers. Antonio Johnson returned a Jaguars fumble 42 yards. Later, Adebo intercepted a Trevor Lawrence pass. Lawrence hit Brian Thomas Jr. for a touchdown, but the 2-point pass was picked off! The Giants stayed in first place in the NFC East, while the Jaguars kept their AFC South lead.

big_words.definition: Caught a pass meant for the other team.
big_words.example: Mateo intercepted a paper airplane flying over his science project.

paragraph: In Mexico City, the 49ers had a shot at a 9-1 record. Brock Purdy zipped a 17-yard touchdown pass to George Kittle. Aaron Jones Sr. ran for a Vikings touchdown. Then the 49ers surged for 21 points in the second quarter. Purdy hit Mike Evans for a score, and Ji'Ayir Brown raced back a pick-six! Christian McCaffrey ran in another touchdown as San Francisco won 35-10. The 49ers reached 9-1, while the Vikings fell to 7-3.

big_words.definition: Moved ahead with a burst of energy.
big_words.example: Zoe surged ahead, stacking blocks to finish her tall tower.

paragraph: Who won the last kick? Drew Stevens did, giving Washington a 22-20 win over Cincinnati! Joe Burrow first zipped a touchdown pass to Tee Higgins for a 10-0 lead. Washington fought back, but Evan McPherson's 56-yard kick put Cincinnati ahead late. Then Jayden Daniels hit Antonio Williams for 2 long passes. Stevens kicked the winning field goal as time ran out. Washington scored on 6 consecutive drives and ended Cincinnati's 5-game winning run.

big_words.definition: Coming one after another, without a break.
big_words.example: Ethan roasted 3 consecutive marshmallows on his camping trip.
